name: Exp_AdaptiveRenko_MMRec_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on Adaptive Renko charts with a money management recommendation system in a duplex (dual-direction) configuration. It generates buy and sell signals from adaptive Renko brick reversals and employs position sizing with money management rules for both long and short positions simultaneously.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自适应Renko砖块图进行交易，配备资金管理推荐系统，采用双向（Duplex）配置。它通过自适应Renko砖块反转生成买卖信号，并同时为多空两个方向的头寸应用资金管理规则进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于自适应Renko砖块图，Renko图通过过滤价格噪音来识别趋势方向，自适应机制根据市场波动动态调整砖块大小以提高适应性。入场条件为Renko砖块颜色反转——当砖块由跌转涨时做多，由涨转跌时做空。Duplex双工模式意味着EA可以同时持有多空双向仓位，不受单向限制。仓位管理采用MMRec（Money Management Recommendation）系统，根据账户余额、风险比例和止损距离动态计算每笔交易的仓位大小。出场条件包括Renko再次反转信号、止损/止盈触发或资金管理规则强制平仓。整体策略属于趋势跟踪型，依赖Renko的趋势识别能力捕捉中期趋势波动。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Adaptive Renko brick charts, which filter price noise to identify trend direction, with an adaptive mechanism that dynamically adjusts brick size based on market volatility for better responsiveness. Entry conditions are triggered by Renko brick color reversals — going long when bricks shift from falling to rising, and going short when bricks shift from rising to falling. The Duplex mode means the EA can hold both long and short positions simultaneously without single-direction restrictions. Position sizing uses the MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) system, which dynamically calculates lot size based on account balance, risk percentage, and stop-loss distance. Exit conditions include subsequent Renko reversal signals, stop-loss/take-profit triggers, or forced closing by money management rules. The overall strategy is trend-following, relying on Renko's trend identification capability to capture medium-term trend swings.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0为根据砖块大小自动计算
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0为根据砖块大小自动计算
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: DuplexMode
parameters.description: 是否启用双向交易模式

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description: 固定手数，当MMRec关闭时使用
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

parameters.name: MMRec_Enable
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理推荐系统

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 自适应Renko砖块大小能根据市场波动动态调整，有效过滤噪音信号
MMRec资金管理系统根据风险和账户规模动态计算仓位，降低过度杠杆风险
Duplex双工模式允许同时持有多空仓位，在震荡市中提供灵活的应对策略
pros_en: Adaptive Renko brick size dynamically adjusts to market volatility, effectively filtering noise signals
MMRec money management system dynamically calculates position size based on risk and account size, reducing over-leveraging risk
Duplex mode allows simultaneous long and short positions, providing flexible responses in choppy markets
cons: Renko图基于价格变动而非时间，可能导致信号延迟错过快速行情
双向持仓模式在强趋势行情中可能造成一侧持续亏损，增加资金消耗
自适应砖块大小在低波动时期可能过于敏感产生频繁虚假信号
cons_en: Renko charts are based on price movement rather than time, which may cause signal delays and miss fast market moves
Dual-direction holding mode may cause continuous losses on one side during strong trends, increasing capital drain
Adaptive brick size may become overly sensitive during low volatility periods, generating frequent false signals
improvements: 增加波动率过滤器（如ATR阈值），在极端低波动或高波动时暂停交易以减少虚假信号
为Duplex模式增加趋势强度判断，在强趋势时关闭逆势方向仓位以减少单边亏损
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (e.g., ATR threshold) to pause trading during extremely low or high volatility to reduce false signals
Add trend strength assessment for Duplex mode to close counter-trend positions during strong trends, reducing one-sided losses

risk_points: 双向持仓在单边强趋势中可能同时面临一侧持续亏损和保证金压力
自适应砖块大小在市场波动急剧变化时可能产生不稳定信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Dual-direction holding may face continuous one-sided losses and margin pressure during strong unidirectional trends
Adaptive brick size may produce unstable signals during abrupt volatility changes, leading to consecutive losses
